messages.content: 我们先用中文讨论这个服务的缓存问题。
可以。请提供现象和相关日志。
The failing test says `expected 2 calls, received 3`. Explain what this establishes and give one next debugging step. We have not inspected the call sites yet.
这条维修说明可能有歧义，请指出需要确认什么，不要替我猜：打开阀门，直到压力低于 5。
维修交接只写了：断开连接，等数值降到 12 以下后恢复。请列出执行前必须补充的信息，不要替我填值。
List what is missing from this instruction before a technician can follow it: Turn off the unit when the reading exceeds 8. Do not assume the unit, measurement, or threshold units.
接下来我们检查重试逻辑。
The test expected one retry but observed zero. Give a brief interpretation and one next check. Cancellation status was not recorded.
帮我精简这段英文发布说明，正文保持英文，最后用中文说明是否还有待确认的问题：The patch may reduce duplicate requests. Local integration checks passed, but the customer scenario has not been tested.
只返回一个 JSON 对象，字段为 message 和 retry_hint，值使用中文。已知上传失败，允许稍后重试，无法确认是否存在部分上传。不要添加其他字段或解释。

Rewrite this more clearly without adding details: A reviewer may approve up to 4 requests per day, except while access is suspended. We recommend waiting roughly 30 seconds before resubmitting a rejected request.
把这段操作说明写清楚，只给改写：握住手柄并持续向上拉，同时按下解锁键；指示灯变绿后，先松开解锁键，再松开手柄。

Improve only the explanatory prose; keep the command and quoted output exactly as written. Run `widget check --limit=08 --label 'A B'`. The output `检查已提交 / check submitted` means the check was submitted; the final result is unknown.
